comparator.name: Chinese Studies
comparator.sourceNotes: Fresh current2026–2027 Chinese Studies official programme supports the stored first-year60 EC and second-year60 EC. Year2 bounded choices retain one S1 Modern Chinese Economy and Development, two S2 Chinese Politics in the Era of Artificial Intelligence and Sociology and Anthropology of Modern China, S1 shared Japan in the21st Century5 and one Mandarin2c abroad15. The latter is one15-EC option, not an extra block; participation requires the propedeuse and entry in the preceding academic year. Current OER Article2.2 confirms no formal specialisations and Article4.2 establishes prerequisites. Year3 numeric groups require Mandarin10, content choice5, language choice5, BA paper10 and genuine open30=60. But both choice-group descriptions demand one option in EACH semester, yielding content10 and language10 and year3 total70. The diagnostic components follow those literal semester instructions with S1 Chinese Labor Migration5/S2 China and the Global Political Economy5 and S1 Reading Chinese News5/S2 Internet Chinese5; all admission conditions are supported by the prior sequence. This diagnostic totals60+60+70=190 EC, not a certified degree reconstruction. The aggregate programme narrative supports one language choice overall and15 total language EC, but does not resolve the conflicting semester group rules. The adopted current programme-specific OER delegates the curriculum to the guide; its transition appendix changes only first-year units and supplies no credit/choice correction. Open30 and thesis10 remain intact; no invented elective reduction, duplicate course or extra abroad credit is used. Bounded selections continue the existing coherent political-economy-and-society emphasis, independently of UCR fit. BA paper is linked to a content choice; supervision requires programme permission.

exception.reason: The current official third-year numeric groups specify5 EC each for content/language choices, but each group simultaneously requires one5-EC choice per semester. The literal instruction yields70 EC in year3 and190 overall. The current adopted OER and transition appendix do not reconcile these rules. A certified180-EC pathway cannot be established without deciding which authoritative rule is corrected; genuine open30 cannot be silently reduced.
